in_english.name: Kelsy
in_english.meaning: A diminutive form of Celia or Kelley
in_english.long_meaning: A short form of the names Celia or Kelley, both of which have Latin origins. Celia is derived from the Latin word caelum, meaning 'heaven.' Kelley is a diminutive form of Grace, derived from the Latin word gratus, meaning 'pleasing' or 'favored.' Kelsy may be considered a combination of both names, with the meaning 'heavenly grace' or 'favored of heaven.'
